title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Shipley (foot) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Will Shipley did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Shipley remains off the fantasy radar with Saquon Barkley on the field.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zack Baun placed in concussion protocol
items.desc: Zack Baun is in the league's concussion protocol.
items.impact: The status of Baun is up in the air heading into Week 4 against the Rams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: DeVonta Smith did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Smith also missed practice to begin last week. His status will need to be monitored the next couple of days.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dallas Goedert (knee) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Dallas Goedert did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Goedert remains likely to miss another game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keaton Mitchell in walking boot
items.desc: Keaton Mitchell was wearing a walking boot on his left foot after practice.
items.impact: Mitchell was listed as a limited participant in practice on Wednesday. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: RJ Harvey (concussion) off injury report
items.desc: RJ Harvey is off the injury report on Wednesday.
items.impact: Harvey was checked for a concussion in Week. He will be good to go in his complimentary role next to J.K. Dobbins.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: J.K. Dobbins (hip) practicing in full for Week 4
items.desc: J.K. Dobbins is practicing in full for Week 4 against the 49ers.
items.impact: Dobbins will remain in his lead role in the Broncos backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: KhaDarel Hodge (knee) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: KhaDarel Hodge did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hodge remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) misses practice
items.desc: Terrance Ferguson did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Ferguson remains likely to be sidelined this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Gervon Dexter Sr. signs extension with Falcons
items.desc: The Falcons signed Gervon Dexter to a four-year, $78 million contract extension.
items.impact: The deal includes $46.5 million guaranteed. The Falcons acquired Dexter from the Bears this past offseason.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jihad Ward signs with Giants
items.desc: The Giants signed Jihad Ward off the Vikings' practice squad.
items.impact: Ward will add depth at linebacker for the Giants.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. traded to Cowboys
items.desc: The Cowboys have acquired Joey Porter Jr. in a trade with the Steelers.
items.impact: Porter had been sidelined the first few weeks of the season with a back injury, while also seeking a new contract. He'll figure to now get that deal with Dallas. He should provide an immediate boost in the secondary for the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rashid Shaheed (hip) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Rashid Shaheed was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Shaheed is a volatile WR4 with upside in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jadarian Price (chest) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jadarian Price was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Price has fumbled each of the past two weeks with last week's turnover leading to him being benched for most of the first half. He is a risky RB2/flex play for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Julian Love (calf) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Julian Love was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Love opened the week day-to-day. He'll be looking to return after being sidelined in Week 3.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: George Holani (rib) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: George Holani was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Holani remains off the fantasy radar in his current role in the Seahawks backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Emmanwori (ankle) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Nick Emmanwori was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Emmanwori has continued to play limited snaps the past two weeks. His status to open this week is a positive sign for him heading into Week 4.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ladd McConkey (foot) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey was a limited participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: McConkey is no longer on the injury report with his rib issue. He remains on track to be good to go for Sunday's game in Seattle.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Derwin James Jr. (hamstring) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Derwin James Jr. was a limited participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jones is dealing with a hamstring injury. He is on track to be good to go for Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Bell (knee) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Chris Bell (knee) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie was limited to start the practice week on Wednesday due to a knee issue. It seems unlikely to affect his availability for Week 4, however, and he seems primed to see more work against the Vikings with Caleb Douglas (ankle) trending towards missing another game for Miami.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Blake Cashman (elbow) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Blake Cashman (elbow) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Cashman is now dealing with an elbow injury of some kind and was limited at Wednesday's practice as a result. He seems likely to play through it in Week 4, but we won't know his status for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Justin Jefferson (ankle) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Justin Jefferson (ankle) did not take part in Minnesota's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jefferson suffered an ankle injury in Week 3 and was not able to practice on Wednesday as a result. He will reportedly have a chance to play in Week 4, so fantasy managers should continue to closely monitor updates about his health throughout the rest of the week to see whether or not that will be the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jackson Powers-Johnson (groin) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jackson Powers-Johnson (groin) missed Las Vegas' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The Raiders may be without their starting guard in Week 4. Powers-Johnson is currently dealing with a groin issue and was unable to practice on Wednesday as a result. His absence would be less than ideal this week ahead of a tough matchup against Kansas City's defense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chamarri Conner (knee) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Chamarri Conner (knee) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: Conner was sidelined due to a knee injury in Week 3, but it looks like he's about ready to make his return to the lineup this week, as he was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday. Kansas City's defense will see a nice boost if he's back in the lineup against the Raiders.
